h200-2gpu-cfg-bf16-vae-resident.description: H200 full-resident 2-GPU CFG profile for LightX2V-aligned Wan best-performance rows.
h200-2gpu-cfg-bf16-vae-resident.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup --enable-cfg-parallel --dit-cpu-offload false --vae-precision bf16 --text-encoder-cpu-offload false --image-encoder-cpu-offload false --vae-cpu-offload false
h200-2gpu-cfg-bf16-vae-resident.notes: Keeps DiT, text/image encoders, and VAE resident on high-memory H200; BF16 VAE aligns with LightX2V best-performance Wan serving path. No cache or torch compile path.

h100-h200-2gpu.description: Hopper 2-GPU CFG-parallel, all components resident, torch.compile — measured fastest.
h100-h200-2gpu.notes: Measured H100 A/B 2026-07-03 (steady-state single_e2e): 35.07s (textenc-offload default) -> 31.068s (-11.4%). Measured on H100; re-validate before publishing new h200 numbers.

default.description: Best known LightX2V command/config for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.
default.notes: Uses explicit fast attention/offload settings; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path.

blackwell-fa2.description: Blackwell LightX2V profile using FlashAttention 2 (validated on B200 via the flux2 blackwell-fa2-flashinfer profile). Same precision class (full-precision, exact attention) as SGLang's FA4 and vLLM-Omni's FlashInfer backend on Blackwell -- flash_attn3/flash_attn4 hit Hopper-only precompiled kernels or a CUDA-toolkit>=13.1 CuTe-DSL requirement not met by this build, so FA2 is the fastest same-class (full-precision) option available here.
blackwell-fa2.notes: Uses the source-built FlashAttention 2 wheel (TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0) already installed for Blackwell; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path. Deliberately NOT using SageAttention here -- it is int8 QK-quantized, a different numeric class from the full-precision attention used elsewhere in this comparison.

h200-fa3.description: H200 fastest available LightX2V command/config for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.
h200-fa3.notes: Uses FlashAttention 3 while preserving CFG/sequence parallelism and offload settings; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path.
